Yasuo|top.identity: Crit-based physical damage fighter. His passive doubles his crit chance and gives him a shield as he moves (Flow). Steel Tempest (Q) strikes in a line and, after two hits, launches a tornado that knocks up; Wind Wall (W) blocks projectiles; Sweeping Blade (E) dashes through a target (Q during the dash = circular strike); Last Breath (R) teleports onto a knocked-up target. He's banned a lot.
Yasuo|top.playstyle: Short trades with the Flow shield, then all-ins with the tornado and ultimate. In top, Yasuo exploits ranged or projectile-based top laners (Varus, Vayne, Heimerdinger, Teemo) thanks to Wind Wall. He's very mechanical and relies on the minion wave for his E's.
Yasuo|top.early_game: Stack Q on minions to have the tornado ready, then engage: E through a minion toward your opponent → Q3 (tornado) → R if your ultimate is available. Your Flow shield absorbs the first trade: only engage when it's full. Keep W for the enemy's most dangerous projectile.
Yasuo|top.level_1: Steel Tempest (Q) first. Stack Q on minions and poke your opponent when they come to last hit.
Yasuo|top.level_2: Sweeping Blade (E). A dash through a unit: E + Q during the dash strikes in a circle. You can stick to your opponent by dashing from minion to minion.
Yasuo|top.level_3: Wind Wall (W). It blocks projectiles: save it for the enemy's key ability (Varus's Q, Heimerdinger's rockets, Teemo's blind).
Yasuo|top.level_6: Last Breath: a teleport onto a knocked-up target (by your tornado or an ally) that keeps them airborne. Combo: E → Q3 tornado → R. You can also use it on your jungler's knock-ups.
power_spikes: Level 6: tornado + ultimate, a big all-in.
First completed item: heavy crit damage.
Two items: dangerous duels and teamfights.
Yasuo|top.lane_plan: Play a neutral wave, stack Q on minions and trade when your Flow shield is full. Keep minions between you and your opponent for your E's. Recall when your wave crashes. Against a ranged champion, step up with W ready.
Yasuo|top.trading: Short trade: E through your opponent → Q → back off with E on a minion. Long trade: Q3 tornado → R → attacks. Engage when your tornado is ready and your shield is full; give up on it against champions who beat you in long melee fights (Renekton, Sett, Nasus).
threats: Fighters who win in melee range (Renekton, Sett).
Singed and champions who make you chase.
Nasus and his attack speed slows.
mistakes: Using W on an unimportant ability.
Engaging without your Flow shield or tornado.
Dashing into an enemy wave with no way out.

matchup_notes.Yone: A mobility duel: wait until he's used his E to engage. Wind Wall barely helps here, his abilities aren't projectiles.
matchup_notes.Renekton: His empowered W stuns you: don't trade with him when his Fury is at 50.
matchup_notes.Malphite: His armor reduces your damage; W against his Q.
matchup_notes.Jayce: W blocks his cannon-form Q + E.
matchup_notes.Varus: Wind Wall blocks his arrows: stick to him.

Yasuo|top.mid_game: Split pushing and skirmishes. Your ultimate works with your allies' knock-ups: stay close to them around objectives.
Yasuo|top.late_game: Go in after your team's knock-ups, ultimate on several targets, Wind Wall to protect your carries from projectiles.
Yasuo|top.ahead: Force duels, take towers and dive with your jungler.
Yasuo|top.behind: Farm, play with your team and wait for knock-ups for your ultimate.
Yasuo|top.win_condition: To win this game, you want to dominate ranged top laners thanks to Wind Wall, then use your ultimate on your team's knock-ups in teamfights.
Yasuo|top.final_tip: Always save your Wind Wall for the enemy's most important ability.
